method: Independent text review by Terra of each raw/target pair and cue against actual stock mode instructions; edits restricted to unambiguous corrections, and ambiguous cases rejected. No audio or human certification.
regional_cues: Every stated cue appears in its raw text, case-insensitively; cue presence does not certify speaker region.
coverage_limits: No exact raw duplicates and scenario group names are unique, but there are similar synthetic families across modes: plant-watering long cases 0037/0142, tiffin-delivery emails 0105/0125, and a sequence of title-cased short messages 0089–0096. Distinct IDs and unique group labels do not establish independent scale or linguistic diversity.
generated_assumptions: Cases are synthetic and often associate one regional word with an otherwise generic scenario; regional labels are supplied metadata, not verified speaker origin. The mate/mates possessive and correction scopes remain ambiguous in rejected examples.
